text:
rajesh_partners: Heads-up — AsterAI submitted an onboarding package for aster-mix-7b-4bit. They want marketplace hosting + an SI bundle with HexaSys. They attached license.md and a small quant artifact. Can legal triage redistribution?

ingrid_legal: Pulling the files. Main questions: is the upstream license permissive or copyleft? Does their contributor agreement forbid redistribution of transformed (quantized) weights? If ambiguous we should request a redistribution addendum.

zack_infra: I spun the quant artifact on a test node. 4-bit runtime works but needs our new fused-kernel flag to avoid fallback. Perf looks good (~35 tok/s on p3-like). I'll push a small runbook and kernel flags.

emma_pm: Marketing asked for a joint launch date — they'd like to line up with HexaSys SI announcement. Proposed date: 2 weeks out (Tue). That requires legal + marketplace ingestion in 5 business days. Tight but maybe doable.

ben_ops: Packaging notes:```
- check license.md vs. contributor_agreement.pdf
- ensure provenance.txt + builder-recipe included
- run security scan (Snyk-like) on container
- create marketplace ticket (if not already)
- confirm SI redistribution scope in doc
```

nina_marketing: We'll prepare a co-branded hero and a short customer story outline. Need AsterAI approval on logo use and a 1-2 sentence product blurb. Who is the contact?

marketplace-bot: Marketplace ingestion: MB-7890 created. Status: manifest validation pending. ETA: ~48h.

ingrid_legal: Quick read: license.md references Apache-2.0 for model code but weights are under a separate data license (Aster-Data-1.0) which has a clause: "derived binary artifacts may be redistributed only with explicit written permission". That's a no-go until we get express permission for quantized derivatives.

rajesh_partners: I pinged Diego at AsterAI. He says they typically allow quantized redistributions for performance partners but need a signed addendum that lists allowed channels (marketplaces, SI bundles, private deployments). He's open to signing.

zack_infra: FYI the artifact contains a license hash mismatch flagged by the manifest validator. Might be because they repackaged weights. We should request original checksum provenance.

ben_ops: Repacked artifacts are common. Ask for: original upstream checksum, source commit, quant recipe, and CI builder image. Also request signing with their key or we won't accept.

ingrid_legal: I'll draft a short "Aster Distributor Addendum" template covering: explicit permission to host quantized derivatives, permitted channels (Redwood hosted API, marketplace SKUs, authorized SI resellers), telemetry opt-in language, export control declaration, and an IP indemnity clause limited to upstream claims.

emma_pm: If Aster signs by Friday morning we can aim for the Tue launch; otherwise fallback to a staged release: announce HexaSys integration first and mark model "coming to marketplace".

nina_marketing: I'll draft two blog variants (full co-announcement vs. staged). Also will prepare social assets but hold publishing until legal confirms.

rajesh_partners: Diego replied: Aster legal can sign our addendum but needs the telemetry paragraph softened (they don't want any per-customer telemetry shared). They prefer aggregate telemetry only.

ingrid_legal: We can do that. Offer: aggregate telemetry by default; per-customer telemetry only with explicit customer consent and an opt-in checkbox in the SI bundle contract. Addendum will reflect that.

marketplace-bot: MB-7890 validation: warnings:
- provenance.txt missing upstream-commit field
- artifact signature absent
- license files present but derivative clause detected (requires addendum)

ben_ops: I've requested upstream-commit + signature from Aster and attached a sample consent checkbox for per-customer telemetry we can drop into SI contracts.

zack_infra: Re-run perf after they resubmitted signed artifact; kernel flag v2 required but stable perf. No CPU fallback. I'll upload logs to MB-7890.

ingrid_legal: Draft addendum posted in thread (excerpt):
"AsterAI Distributor Addendum: AsterAI grants Redwood Inference and authorized resellers the non-exclusive right to host, cache, and distribute quantized derivative artifacts of aster-mix-7b-4bit on cloud marketplaces, Redwood-hosted endpoints, Dedicated customer pools, and as part of SI bundles. Telemetry: only aggregated usage metrics may be collected and shared; per-customer telemetry requires explicit customer opt-in. Export compliance: AsterAI to provide EAR classification. This addendum is contingent on proper provenance and artifact signing."

rajesh_partners: Action items:
- rajesh_partners: get signed addendum and logo approval from Diego by Fri AM
- ingrid_legal: finalize addendum text and prepare a one-page summary for HexaSys
- zack_infra: upload perf + kernel flags to MB-7890 by EOD
- ben_ops: verify artifact provenance and request signature if still missing
- nina_marketing: ready co-announcement drafts; hold publish until signed

emma_pm: I'll create a release cadence doc with the staged fallback plan and coordinate HexaSys dates.

rajesh_partners: Diego confirmed Aster legal will sign and provided a contact for logo approval. They're okay with aggregate telemetry only; they asked we don't include per-customer examples in the public blog.

ingrid_legal: Noted. I'll remove per-customer telemetry examples from the public draft. Once signed addendum is in MB-7890 we can proceed with ingestion.

marketplace-bot: MB-7890 updated: manifest validated after signature upload. Next: automated security scan (approx 24h).

nina_marketing: Great progress — I'll queue the content for review once legal drops the signed addendum. Thanks all :rocket:
